founder_manual_acceptance_open: On a physical 360px-class phone with keyboard and enlarged text/screen reader, open a long-named Group copy with long participant names and deep branches. Navigate/focus all labels, active participant, add/edit question/follow-up, blank answer, collapse, Save and Back. Check privacy/error/save text remains reachable and nothing is covered.

As a verified private user, explicitly share a selected existing session. Record original IDs/answers/branches. Edit/save Group text, participant answer and deep branch, reopen/refresh on a second device. Verify Group revision/history advances once and both local/private originals stay unchanged. No extra private/local item is created.

Repeat editing as Group admin, editor and contributor-own. Repeat as contributor-other/viewer/nonmember/pending/removed and revoked member; denied actors must not edit. An organisation owner/admin with no Group grant must remain denied. Repeat archived/deleted Group and deleted entry.

Open the same revision on two authorised devices. Save A, then save B. B must retain its draft and show review; Keep draft must not write/retry. Explicit Discard draft and load latest replaces B's draft. Reapply desired edits only after reviewing the latest version, then save against that version.

With a controlled non-destructive connection interruption, exercise response-lost saves both applied and not applied. Check save status must confirm exact remote content or enable explicit retry only against the unchanged baseline. Competing newer content requires review. No duplicate item/history write or silent overwrite.

While editing/opening participant/question/report/JSON/history/close dialogs, sign out or switch UID. Prior content/dialogs must disappear; delayed responses must not render, copy, export or write under the next UID. Revoke access on another device before Save/export confirmation and confirm safe unavailable state.

Edit then Back/close: Cancel retains draft, Discard closes without applying the draft, Save and close closes only after confirmed success. For an unconfirmed save, close text must admit the write may already have applied; discard cannot undo it.

Export selected/all-participant PDF and saved JSON after editing. Confirm saved content and branch ownership, not unsaved edits. Verify share/download/print accessibility and privacy confirmation; downloaded copies cannot be revoked.

Check guest local and private account editor flows, original clipboard UID protection and uncertain DELETE/Undo recovery; check organisation permission, blank-answer save, template confirmation, participants/lifecycle/export. Refresh guest/nonmember to the session list and reopen manually (accepted IP19).
